items.name: aetheris-voyage
items.title: Aetheris Voyage
items.description: A full-viewport hero for a fictional dream-travel brand. A conic-gradient nebula slowly rotates behind an ultra-wide, letter-spaced headline in moon-paper white, a faint coral dawn low on the horizon. Nav, headline and CTA stagger in on load. The scene feels weightless, like the site is drifting.

items.name: echo-cave
items.title: Echo Cave
items.description: A sound studio portfolio that opens on a clay bat in headphones hanging in front of its own wordmark. Click anywhere and rings of sonar spread from the pointer, lighting every project title they cross. The scroll flies past its ears into the cave studio, and the showreel cassette lands on the desk as the work index, where each track plays a 3 second sample only when pressed.

items.name: fieldnote
items.title: Fieldnote
items.description: A diagram notebook landing on cream paper: scroll scrubs a fountain pen finishing its ink line while a corner sketch draws itself in step with the film. Below it every illustration inks itself in as it enters view, margin notes ring a real product screen, and Nib, a small ink mascot, walks a drawn path that links each section down to a per-editor price you set yourself.

items.name: glasshouse-nine
items.title: Glasshouse Nine
items.description: A nursery landing with an honest heartbeat: the hero drifts you through ferns and misted Victorian glass, the bench list shows live counts and keeps sold-out plants visible with their re-rooting dates, and pointing at any row floats a photo of the actual plant.

items.name: jacquard-hall
items.title: Jacquard Hall
items.description: A brick mill opens on a filmed orbit of a jacquard loom, scrubbed by scroll, with a punch card you draw into on the first screen. A React Three Fiber loom lifts its warp threads from your card and weaves the cloth pick by pick, then 4 house cloths turn on their bolts. The mill-visit form arrives with your card attached as a weave draft.

items.name: lathe-lacquer
items.title: Lathe & Lacquer
items.description: A filmed gouge cuts a spinning walnut blank as you scroll, then a live three.js lathe takes over: the bowl's profile carves itself pass by pass and a coat of oxblood lacquer spreads across the grain. Drag to walk round it, then orbit 4 finished pieces on a turntable and price a commission.

items.name: leaf-assay
items.title: Leaf Assay
items.description: A tea shop that opens on a glass pot: scroll steeps the leaves frame by frame while a readout counts the 3 minute steep. Below it, a flavour wheel stands in for the filter sidebar, so tapping smoky, floral or malty slides the matching teas to the front, and each quick view runs a steep timer over the looping pot.

items.name: lumen-observatory
items.title: Lumen Observatory
items.description: A 3D-feel hero without WebGL: three parallax star layers, elliptical orbit lines, and a brass-ringed planet that tilts toward your cursor. Scroll pulls you deeper into the field. Feels like a telescope UI from a kinder future.

items.name: ninety-seconds
items.title: Ninety Seconds
items.description: One Neapolitan pizza is made in the middle of the screen as you scroll: a floured ball opens into a round, tomato spirals out, fior di latte and basil fall in, and a stone oven rises around it. A readout gives the real number of each step, 72 hours for the dough and about 90 seconds at about 450 °C, and changes only when the picture does. At the end you drag the first slice off the board, the cheese stretching as far as you pull.

items.name: nordlys-fintech
items.title: Nordlys Fintech
items.description: A complete landing page for a Nordic fintech. Real aurora ripples over a frozen fjord above the fold; feature cards sit on solid graphite; numbers count up as they enter the viewport. Cool, calm and expensive-feeling.

items.name: roll-call
items.title: Roll Call
items.description: A frozen steel plate on a cobalt counter makes one cup of dragon fruit and mango rolled ice cream as you scroll: the pour, the fruit, the chop, the sheet, six rolls, the cup and the toppings. A corner readout gives the plate at -25 °C and the time the cream has been on it, changing only when the picture does. Once the cup is topped, a tap anywhere throws its toppings.

items.name: side-eye
items.title: Side Eye
items.description: A knitwear shop on a tomato red ground where a cream baby alpaca turns her head to keep your cursor in view, or your finger on a phone. Pick one of four jumper colours and she answers in a speech bubble, from a slow blink for oatmeal to a full turn away for bright green. The label names the animal, the herd and the farm.

items.name: snail-courier
items.title: Snail Courier
items.description: A courier landing where a garden snail carries one parcel across a mint page at one constant speed as you scroll. The tracking card's countdown is the crawl, so it reaches 00:00:00 as the parcel lands. Pick a route below and get one date, the one the courier has met 30 days running.

items.name: solstice-festival
items.title: Solstice Festival
items.description: A festival announcement hero soaked in amber light. A huge sun disc rises behind layered hills and the lineup sits below as one wrapping poster bill. Headline letters flare in one by one, pure golden-hour drama.

items.name: sumi-atelier
items.title: Sumi Atelier
items.description: An identity studio portfolio on warm rice paper: scroll pushes the camera into a pool of black sumi ink while three chapter cards land on their own seconds of the film. In the work index the cursor leaves a wash that pools wider where the brush rests, and choosing a project bleeds its plate in from the point you chose it, ending on a looping ink edge behind the commission form.

items.name: ternary-systems
items.title: Ternary Systems
items.description: A site for a test runner with three answers: pass, fail and unsure. Scroll scrubs a slow push across a graphite keyboard while the sidebar compiles one file per chapter, and each code sample runs as it lands. Press ⌘K for a working command palette that jumps to any section or copies the install command.

items.name: twist-stop
items.title: Twist Stop
items.description: The first screen is the shop's machine, and it works. Pick one or two flavours, hold the red lever and a striped twist pours in 3D, one turn at a time up to 6, where the amber lamp lights. Add sprinkles or chocolate pearls, then send the link, and your friend opens that exact cone.

items.name: wren
items.title: Wren
items.description: A home-robot app that feels like hardware: a live camera card that tags what the robot sees, a voice orb that turns a sentence into a queued task, a CSS-3D floor plan you spin with a finger while the robot re-plans around a toy, and teach-by-demonstration with a projected 3D skeleton. Ships inside a scroll tour where the phone swings between chapters over the footage.
